info.title: v2.global_product.create_publish_task
info.description: Create publish task for global item. Only for China mainland sellers and Korean sellers.

post.description: Create publish task for global item. Only for China mainland sellers and Korean sellers.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: days_to_ship
parameters.description: Days to ship, it's mandatory if is_pre_order is true.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of item. If you upload this field, we will take your value, so you should pass the value in the local language, if you don't upload this field, Shopee will automatically translate your global product description into the local language.

parameters.name: description_info
parameters.description: New description field. Only whitelist sellers can use it. If you use the field, please upload the description_type=extended otherwise api will return error. If you don't use this field, you don't need to upload the description_type or upload description_type=normal. If you upload this field, we will take your value, so you should pass the value in the local language, if you don't upload this field, Shopee will automatically translate your global product description into the local language.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: If this logistic channel is enabled.

parameters.name: extended_description
parameters.description: If description_type is extended , Description information should be set by this field.

parameters.name: field_list
parameters.description: Field of extended description.

parameters.name: field_type
parameters.description: Type of extended description field ：values: See Data Definition- description_field_type (text , image).

parameters.name: global_item_id
parameters.description: Id of global item.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Image information of item.

parameters.name: image_id_list
parameters.description: Image id list of item.

parameters.name: image_info
parameters.description: If field_type is image，image url will be set by this field.

parameters.name: is_free
parameters.description: If this logistic channel is free.

parameters.name: is_pre_order
parameters.description: If this item is preorder.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Item information.

parameters.name: item_name
parameters.description: Name of item. If you upload this field, we will take your value, so you should pass the value in the local language, if you don't upload this field, Shopee will automatically translate your global product name into the local language.

parameters.name: item_status
parameters.description: Status of item.

parameters.name: logistic
parameters.description: Logistic information of item.

parameters.name: logistic_id
parameters.description: Logistic id.

parameters.name: merchant_id
parameters.description: Shopee’s unique identifier for a merchant. Required for all merchant level requests(CB CNSC user calling global product related APIs).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model information of item.

parameters.name: model_status
parameters.description: can be "NORMAL" or "UNAVAILABLE". Normal models can be sold on the buyer's side, and UNAVAILABLE models cannot be sold on the buyer's side. If you do not upload this field, the model status will be considered as "NORMAL".

parameters.name: original_price
parameters.description: Original price of model. If you upload this field, we will take your value, so you should pass the value in local currency, if you don't upload this field, Shopee will automatically calculate the price.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: pre_order
parameters.description: Preorder information of item.

parameters.name: shipping_fee
parameters.description: Shipping fee.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Id of shop to publish to.

parameters.name: shop_region
parameters.description: Region of shop.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, merchant_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: size_chart
parameters.description: Size chart of item. Only support image_id for now

parameters.name: size_id
parameters.description: Size id.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: If field_type is text， text information will be set by this field.

parameters.name: tier_index
parameters.description: Tier index of model.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
